Specification: This module specifies an age-aware message channel in which messages are wrapped into boxes that carry both the original message content and an integer-valued transit age. The state tracks the set of boxed messages currently in transit and the set of messages delivered in the current transition, with actions for picking up new messages, delivering a nondeterministically chosen subset addressed to a given receiver, and advancing the age of all in-transit boxes. The specification includes initialization and a type invariant, but it does not define a full temporal specification such as Spec, fairness, or liveness properties; it focuses on the state representation and transition-level behavior of the channel.
